children.title: Execution levels
Ordered capability bands
children.text: A session takes the highest level containing its resolved base model whose minimum effort it meets. Thresholds for the same model strictly increase with level; duplicate or decreasing thresholds refuse level_min_effort_order_invalid.

children.title: Launch options
children.text: Each stored option is exactly model and min_effort. Native listings expand it into available surface selectors at the minimum effort; stored rows contain no surface, context, speed or fallback.

children.title: Base model and minimum effort
children.text: The shipped scheme has 5 INTERN low rows, 7 JUNIOR rows (Grok/Terra/Sonnet high; Opus/Sol/Fable/Astra low), 4 SENIOR medium rows (Opus/Sol/Fable/Astra), and 2 PRINCIPAL xhigh rows (Fable/Astra). Speed does not change membership. Published catalog efforts constrain writes.
children.evidence: Production QA run 45473 / artifact 32323 and universe.levels.get, 2026-10-13.

children.text: Ordered base-model/min_effort thresholds determine the highest matching session level. Production has 18 approved rows across INTERN, JUNIOR, SENIOR and PRINCIPAL; no model rank table participates.
children.evidence: Production launch.622: QA run 45473 / artifact 32323; universe.levels.get reread 2026-10-13. Session resolution mechanics checked in the routing guide.

children.title: Launch option
Harness surface
children.text: Harness surface is not a stored level-row field. Per-machine native listings determine launchable surfaces; Settings shows Launchable on chips. Unsupported listings name the missing adapter and recovery, rather than inventing availability.
children.evidence: Settings harness chips: QA run 45473 / artifact 32323. Unsupported Claude listing refusal also present in this session launch receipt; other surface mechanics observed in source.

children.title: Model or native selector
children.text: Rows store a base-model ID without native effort/speed suffixes. Placement expands observed native selectors; observed model/effort facts outrank requested launch stamps. Known older catalog models without explicit rows demote exactly one class at the same effort; older bottom-class models and single-class Grok refuse.

children.title: Reasoning effort
children.text: min_effort is the row threshold; actual effort resolves session membership. Effort order is none < minimal < low < medium < high < xhigh (extra-high) < max < ultra. Native embedded effort may fill missing facts; speed suffixes are ignored. Unknown models or unpublished efforts resolve no level and work claims/launches refuse session_below_intern; refresh catalog/native facts or select a supported model and effort before retrying.

children.title: Context window
children.text: Context window is not stored in Levels and does not determine membership. An exact launch may request context only where its receiving surface supports it. Exact surface/model/effort/context knobs and --level are exclusive; preview the observed native availability before launch.

children.title: No cross-level fallback
children.text: There is no exhausted-pool cross-level fallback. Cursor Opus medium is SENIOR and cannot escape JUNIOR exhaustion. No usable selection refuses level_no_capacity with each candidate reason and recovery; capacity-stopped workers use same-level recovery excluding the refused model.
Stored launch options are base model/min_effort rows. Surface, native selector and context are resolved for placement or supplied on an exact launch override.
children.evidence: Production universe.levels.get, 2026-10-13; native expansion mechanics observed in the routing guide.

children.title: Quota pools
children.text: Candidates read only the pools their model consumes. Readable zero blocks; unreadable or missing quota is unknown. Claude has a separate 5-hour cap. Cursor has exactly two monthly pools, ordered universe-wide; pool preference affects consumption, never level membership.
children.evidence: Two Cursor rows proved by QA run 45473 / artifact 32323; current order reread through universe.cursor_quota_order.get, 2026-10-13. Other quota semantics observed in the routing guide.

children.title: Cursor monthly pool order
children.text: Cursor Models precedes Other Models in the verified production definition. Admins can reverse the two rows in Settings or replace the whole order with the registered CLI. This is universe-wide, not per machine; available Cursor candidates prefer the earlier pool before headroom.
recipes: yoke universe cursor-quota-order set --pool 'Cursor Models' --pool 'Other Models'
children.evidence: Production QA run 45473 / artifact 32323 proves two rows and move controls; universe.cursor_quota_order.get reread 2026-10-13. Mutation and placement mechanics observed in source.

children.title: No usable option
children.text: level_no_capacity reports every candidate refusal and recovery. Unknown native listings require a probe; unsupported listings require a declared adapter or another observed surface. Unknown quota is not exhausted, and another level is never borrowed.
